# BabakCast

> An Android app for downloading and sharing media, and for summarizing YouTube transcripts with an AI provider you configure. Built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.

## Overview

BabakCast downloads media from YouTube, X (Twitter), Instagram and LinkedIn, copies or shares the text of X posts, and summarizes YouTube transcripts with the AI provider you set up yourself. Downloads can be cut to a time range and split into numbered parts for sharing. The app has no developer backend, accounts or analytics. Built with Clean Architecture and MVVM.

## Technical Details

- Language: Kotlin
- Framework: Jetpack Compose, Android SDK
- Architecture: Clean Architecture + MVVM
- Build: Gradle (Kotlin DSL)
- License: Apache-2.0

## Key Files

- `app/src/main/java/` — Application source code
- `build.gradle.kts` — Build configuration
- `gradle.properties` — Also where `VERSION_NAME`/`VERSION_CODE` live
- `CLAUDE.md` — AI session instructions
